propositions: Implemented tickets must pass a plan-review gate at close time if plan or pinned upstream dependencies changed during execution, without re-running review inside close or invalidating on implementation file changes alone
The close gate accepts code-drift changes but enforces signature validity, registry currency, phase compatibility, material currency, and configured pin enforcement
Close gate checks run under the existing transaction lock after structural checks but before STATUS append, re-verifying fresh state to catch concurrent plan/signature/phase/material/pin changes

Pin health checks are advisory when enforce_plan_material_pins=false; all other validity criteria (unsigned, reopened, stale-registry, material-drift, malformed metadata, phase incompatibility) always block close regardless of pin enforcement
Failure returns an exact verdict-prefixed error message directing users to run review-plan separately, with no model/network calls and fail-closed exception handling as unavailable
Existing exemptions (bugs, session logs, code reviews, identities, idea→closed) and force-close bypass remain unchanged; generic pre_status_check callback is available for other transaction policies
